extraction_scope: Worker-6 mechanism adjudication: phenotype cytotoxicity and model membrane/ROS context preserved without overclaiming a direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports cell-type- and concentration-dependent cytotoxicity of flaxseed LOBs in A375, SK-BR-3, and MCF7 cell-line assays; this is phenotype-level activity evidence, not a direct molecular target mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: LDH cytotoxicity readout does not identify an intact-cell molecular target or death pathway.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The authors use micron-sized phospholipid bubbles as a model membrane system and report hydrophobicity-correlated interaction order with LOB3 strongest and [MetO]-LOB2 weakest; final curation treats this as model-membrane mechanistic context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model phospholipid-bubble interaction is not promoted to a direct intact-cell pore-forming or membrane-disruption mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper discusses ROS/anti-oxidative activity as a possible contributor based on prior flaxseed oil stability context; it remains a hypothesis, not a directly measured mechanism in this study.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No paper-local ROS assay, oxidative stress quantification, apoptosis assay, or target-pathway experiment was found in XML/PDF/OA package.
